title: Catalyst
subtitle: feminism, theory, technoscience
why: Their pieces on feminist theory and digital feminisms are extremely well done and insightful
description: Catalyst publishes peer-reviewed critically and theoretically engaged feminist STS scholarship that reroutes the gendered, queer, raced, colonial, militarized, and political-economic beings and doings of technoscience. Its mission is to support innovation in feminist STS and related areas of study, as well as to provide a venue for the publishing of activist feminist and critical theory concerning matters of science, technology, information, medicine, media, and more
